bio: This restaurant is located in the town centre, housed in one of its oldest buildings. The romantic natural stone-vaulted ceiling makes for a distinctive atmosphere. Your charming hostess, Monika Pirchmoser, provides cordial hospitality, guided by her personal creed, which is emblazoned on her apron: leben, genießen, glücklich sein ("live, enjoy, be happy"). Tamara Lerchner runs the kitchen, presenting an eclectic menu ranging from Asian glass noodle salad and Mediterranean pasta dishes to a contemporary take on roast beef with a port sauce. Be sure to leave room for the legendary Kaiserschmarrn! The terrace out front is lovely in warm weather.
